estimates.assumptions: 2 tbsp vegetable oil = 28 g; pure oil contains no carbohydrates
450 g raw skinless chicken breast meat; plain meat contains no carbohydrates
3 tbsp chopped garlic ≈ 27 g; using 31 g carbs and 2 g fiber per 100 g
3 tbsp chopped shallots ≈ 30 g; using 23 g carbs and 4.3 g fiber per 100 g for shallots
3 medium red chillies ≈ 45 g (edible portion); using 20 g carbs and 3 g fiber per 100 g for red chillies
2 tbsp fish sauce ≈ 30 g; using 4 g carbs per 100 g, negligible fiber
2 tsp soy sauce ≈ 10 g; using 5 g carbs per 100 g, negligible fiber
2 tsp sugar ≈ 8 g; sugar is 100% carbohydrate
Handful fresh basil leaves ≈ 15 g; using ~5 g carbs and 3 g fiber per 100 g
